Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 17
G.N. No. S 300/1998
REVISED EDITION 2000
(31st January 2000)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Laws Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 1st May 1998:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 30th May 1998, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
(1) The Arms Offences Act (Chapter 14)
(2) The Carriage of Goods by Sea Act (Chapter 33)
(3) The Civil Defence Shelter Act (Chapter 42A)
(4) The Commercial and Industrial Security Corporation Act (Chapter 47)
(5) The Community Mediation Centres Act (Chapter 49A)
(6) The Criminal Law (Temporary Provisions) Act (Chapter 67)
(7) The Currency Act (Chapter 69)
(8) The Factories Act (Chapter 104)
(9) The Government Procurement Act (Chapter 120)
(10) The Hazardous Waste (Control of Export, Import and Transit) Act (Chapter 122A)
(11) The Jurong Town Corporation Act (Chapter 150)
(12) The Medical Registration Act (Chapter 174)
(13) The Sentosa Development Corporation Act (Chapter 291)
(14) The Skills Development Levy Act (Chapter 306)
(15) The Travel Agents Act (Chapter 334)
[G.N. No.S 300/98]
